## Task 1 · The drone (3 marks)

A drone flies with speed 10 and the input (1, −1) at 50 frames per second.

a) Normalize the input and give the velocity. What is the step per frame?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) The drone hits the floor (n = (0, 1)) with v = (6, −8). Find the
velocity after the bounce with e = 1 and with e = 0.5. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

c) After the bounce with e = 1, which way does the sprite face? Give the
angle with atan2. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · The dungeon floor (2 marks)

a) A trap must be at least 4 steps from the start; 50 % of the floor tiles
are allowed. How many draws does the generator need on average? 90 % of
the seeds give a valid floor: how many seeds does it try on average?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) Each of 5 rooms has: empty 70, chest 20 (+15 coins), gem 10 (+40 coins).
Find the expected coins per floor and P(no chest on the floor). (1 mark)
